title.en: Income Tax (Eligible Courses in Section 14ZG(5)) Rules 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Income Tax (Eligible Courses in Section 14ZG(5)) Rules 2024 and come into operation on 26 April 2024.

heading.en: Website from which eligible courses are accessible

text.en:
2. For the purposes of paragraph (b) of the definition of “eligible course” in section 14ZG(5) of the Act, the eligible courses are specified on an Internet website that is accessible from the Internet website at https://go.gov.sg/eis‑training.
[S 208/2025 wef 28/03/2025]
